title: YEEZY POWERPHASE
description: In September 2019, the adidas Yeezy PowerPhase was reintroduced in a three colorway collection designed around Kanye West's trademark selection of earth tones. A Simple Brown shade is draped across this variation's suede upper, mesh lining and laces. Contrast comes from the retro logo window and metallic 'Calabasas' lettering alongside the Three-Stripes. The classic rubber cupsole is positioned below for support.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 KIDS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Lundmark Non-Reflective' sneaker brings together form and function, melding future-forward design and athletic performance. Unveiled in July 2019, this update presents a translucent monofilament stripe traversing the lateral of a duo-tone Primeknit upper. Patterned rope laces are integrated into the bootie. Underfoot, a semi-transparent tubular Boost-assisted sole provides energized cushioning.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER KIDS
description: An amalgam of sneaker and sandal, the adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Kids ‘MX Cream Clay’ features a futuristic build constructed from a blend of injected EVA and harvested algae. Ventilation ports of varying sizes are apportioned throughout the sculpted upper, which is finished in a cream-colored hue with brushstroke-like hits of brown and grey. The swirling hues extend to the outsole, featuring a wavy tread for grippy traction.
